1.text: Bana, nimutegere amatwi ibyo so abigisha,Mushishikarire kwiga ubuhanga.

2.text: Ntimukareke amategeko yanjye,Kuko mbigisha ibyigisho byiza.

3.text: Nabereye data umwana,Kandi ndi ikinege gikundwa na mama cyane.

4.text: Yaranyigishaga akambwira ati“Ukomeze amagambo yanjye mu mutima wawe,Witondere amategeko yanjye,Ubone kubaho.

5.text: Shaka ubwenge shaka n'ubuhanga,Ntubwibagirwe, ntuteshuke amagambo ava mu kanwa kanjye.

7.text: Ubwenge muri byose ni bwo ngenzi,Nuko rero shaka ubwenge,Ndetse ibyo utunze byose ubishakishe ubuhanga.

8.text: Ubukuze na bwo buzagukuza,Nubukomeza buzaguhesha icyubahiro.

9.text: Buzagutamiriza imbabazi ho umurimbo,Buzakwambika ikamba ry'ubwiza.”

10.text: Mwana wanjye, umva kandi emera amagambo yanjye,Ni bwo imyaka yo kubaho kwawe izagwira.

11.text: Nakwigishije ingeso z'ubwenge,Nakuyoboye mu nzira zitunganye.

12.text: Nugenda intambwe zawe ntizizateba,Kandi niwiruka ntuzasitara.

13.text: Ukomeze cyane icyo wigishijwe ntukireke,Ugihamane kuko ari cyo bugingo bwawe.

14.text: Ntukajye mu nzira y'inkozi z'ibibi,Kandi ntukagendere mu migenzereze y'abantu babi.

15.text: Ujye uyitaza ntuyinyuremo,Uyiteshuke uce mu yindi.

16.text: Ababi ntibasinzira keretse bakoze ibibi,Kandi ntibatora agatotsi batagize uwo bagusha,

17.text: Kuko barya umutsima wo gukiranirwa,Kandi banywa vino y'urugomo.

18.text: Ariko inzira y'umukiranutsi ni nk'umuseke utambitse,Ugakomeza gukura ukageza ku manywa y'ihangu.

20.text: Mwana wanjye, ita ku magambo yanjye,Tegere ugutwi ibyo mvuga.

21.text: Ntibive imbere y'amaso yawe,Ubikomeze mu mutima wawe imbere.

22.text: Kuko ari byo bugingo bw'ababibonye,Bikaba umuze muke w'umubiri wabo wose.

23.text: Rinda umutima wawe kuruta ibindi byose birindwa,Kuko ari ho iby'ubugingo bikomokaho.

24.text: Ikureho umunwa uvuga iby'ubugome,Kandi ururimi ruvuga iby'ubugoryi urushyire kure yawe.

26.text: Tunganya inzira y'ibirenge byawe,Kandi imigendere yawe yose ikomezwe.

27.text: Ntuhindukirire iburyo cyangwa ibumoso,Ukure ikirenge cyawe mu bibi.
